New day new hack! Let's plan & Ideate!

Overview of the hack:
The VAST Builders Challenge is a three-city technical event series bringing together founders and engineers across New York, London, and San Francisco to build production-ready AI systems.
Spend the day building agents to unlock the value of video. Because video is hard to search and analyze,  most of it stays in storage, unwatched and underused.
Experiment with the latest AI infrastructure, collaborate with other ambitious builders, and turn your ideas into shippable prototypes - with access to expert guidance, compute, and the tools you need to ship.
Hosted with VAST Data in collaboration with NVIDIA, SpaceXAI, CoreWeave and Weights & Biases.
Note: Registration closes on 15th October.
Prizes

1st place: NVIDIA DGX Spark™
HuggingFace Microduck
Cursor Credits
Cash Gift Cards
The Builders Stack
Here's what you get out of the box, a lightning-quick setup:

Video understanding: reason over a video clip with NVIDIA Cosmos.
Semantic search: find moments across hours of footage using natural language.
Object detection: real-time detection and tracking across frames with YOLO.
General-purpose LLMs: models from Weights & Biases to power your application logic (e.g. video agents).
The VAST AI OS orchestrates the video ingestion and data layer, models are served on CoreWeave GPUs, and builders ship with Cursor.
Build your own video agent or something no one’s thought of. We'll share the videos to get you started on building video agents.

My inspirations:

I am thinking of building some sort of video agent that does some detection in specialised places.. such as Xray detection cameras or lidar cameras on something such as airport security etc.
Second inspiration is to think around the enablement of smart glasses to help people do something. For e.g. helping a grandmother assemble a PC or something.. essentially finding something that previously required eyes that knew how to process things and decide which can be done by an AI agent via an app on a smart glass (ofc for hack demo purpose we're gonna show that as a feed on the computer)

Venue Rules:

No under-18s. Events are for adults only, unless Night Office has agreed otherwise in writing before the event.
No alcohol without approval. Alcohol is only allowed if Night Office has approved it in writing in advance. It must never be sold, including through tickets, bar tabs or donations. Only over-18s may drink, and the Night Office member of staff can stop service at any time.
Kitchen: fridge, kettle and coffee only. Do not use microwaves, ovens or any other appliance without the Night Office member of staff's OK. No cooking anywhere in the building.
Stay in the booked space. Do not enter offices, meeting rooms, terraces or other floors unless they are part of your booking.
Report damage immediately. Tell the Night Office member of staff straight away about anything broken, marked or spilled, however small.
No smoking or vaping anywhere in the building, including terraces and phone booths.
No candles, open flames or your own appliances.This includes heaters, hotplates and extension leads.
Keep doors closed. Do not prop doors open or let anyone follow you in. Every guest is signed in by the Night Office member of staff.
Leave it as you found it. Put furniture back, bag your rubbish and take your belongings with you. Nothing is stuck to walls, doors or glass.
If the fire alarm sounds, leave. Follow the Night Office member of staff's instructions and use the nearest exit. Do not use lifts.
Respect the staff. Treat Night Office, venue, housekeeping and security staff with courtesy. Anyone who is disrespectful will be asked to leave.
Don't touch building equipment. Leave CCTV, card readers, heating and cooling controls and plant alone, and do not enter bin rooms.
Nothing dangerous or illegal. Do not bring harmful or dangerous items into the building, and nothing illegal may happen at the event.
Report accidents and near misses. Tell the Night Office member of staff about any injury or near miss, however minor. First aid boxes are in the kitchens.
Your belongings are your responsibility. Anything left behind after the event may be thrown away.
No dogs or other pets, except assistance dogs.
Photos and video. Night Office may take photos and video at events for promotional use. If you don't want to be photographed, tell the Night Office member of staff.
The host's decision is final. They can stop an activity or ask anyone to leave. The venue manager has the final say over the host.
Note: This event will be photographed and filmed. By attending, you consent to appearing in photos and videos that may be used for social media and promotional materials.

Please be aware of the house rules (→ nightoffice.co).
